registration: The git commit that adds this file is the registration; it precedes every SEC fetch of this strand for dividend evidence. sha256 in tr-protocol-1.0.0.sha256. Changes need a new version.
priorKnowledge: Written after reading docs/quant-recovery/v9/portfolio/dividend-evidence.json (completeness counts per title and gap quarters: MSFT/WMT 47/47, NVDA 46/47, IBM 43/47, A 28/47, JPM 15/47, XOM 14/47, META 1/11) and the V9 harvester code. V9 events are a candidate list only; every event admitted here is re-extracted from a body fetched by this strand.
purpose: Research total-return register (dividends) for the titles of the V9/V10 ledger and study populations with the largest study effect. Strictly separates PRICE_RETURN, TOTAL_RETURN, unresolved corporate actions and unknown terminal proceeds.

period.expectedQuarters: one regular cash dividend per record-date calendar quarter 2015Q1..2026Q3; META from 2024Q1 (first declared dividend 2024-02-01)

allowed: 8-K and 8-K exhibits (Item 8.01/7.01/2.02, EX-99 dividend declarations and earnings releases)
10-Q/10-K primary documents (dividend sentences and tables with record and payment dates)
inline XBRL dei/us-gaap dividend date facts in those documents
sources.access: scripts/quant/sec/http_client.py, User-Agent 'VisionUniverseResearch info@visionuniverse.de', <= 1 request/second for this harvester (strand total <= 2/s), private cache scratchpad/v10-private/corporate-actions/div-cache. Availability time from the filing's SGML index-headers ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME (US/Eastern -> UTC), never from submissions.zip.
sources.discovery: (a) every document listed as attestation in the V9 dividend-evidence (candidate list only, re-fetched); (b) every 10-Q/10-K primary document of the title filed 2014-10-01..2026-10-27; (c) for each quarter without an admitted event after (a)+(b): EDGAR full-text search with the CIK, forms 8-K,10-Q,10-K and dateRange [quarterStart-100d, quarterEnd+45d] for each query in GAP_QUERIES (all pages, at most 300 hits per query), and all exhibits of 8-Ks of the title in that range with items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01 or empty items.

extraction: The V9 extractors (scripts/quant/v9/portfolio/harvest_dividends.py: sentence_events, table_events, installment_events, partial_events) are reused unchanged as parsing functions; a field not stated in the document stays null.

eventAdmission.rule: A regular cash dividend event (title, recordDate) is admitted iff at least one extraction from a body fetched by this strand states recordDate, payDate and a contemporaneous per-share amount in the same sentence/table row, intentOnly is false, kind is REGULAR, and no other admitted extraction for the same recordDate states a different payDate or contemporaneous amount (conflict -> EVENT_CONFLICT, not admitted).
eventAdmission.payDate: the stated payment date; an ex-dividend date is never used as payment date.
eventAdmission.exDate: never sourced; recorded only as exDateDerived from the record date by the settlement-cycle rule (T+3 until 2017-09-06: record - 2 business days; T+2 from 2017-09-07: record - 1 business day; T+1 from 2024-05-28: record date), flagged DERIVED_SETTLEMENT_RULE_NOT_SOURCED.
eventAdmission.declarationDate: stated date if present, else null.
eventAdmission.availability: SEC acceptance (index-headers) of the earliest admitted source; issuer declaration date is reported separately and never replaces the SEC time.
eventAdmission.sourcesPerEvent: every admitted attestation: accession, url, sha256 of the full body, form, quote <= 300 characters, acceptanceUtc and header sha256.

splitConsistency.rule: amount is kept in contemporaneous per-share units. seriesUnitFactor = product of the provider splitFactors of quant/data/market/discover-series-long/ref_<T>.json with date > exDateDerived; amountSeriesUnits = amount / seriesUnitFactor. Each provider split factor inside the period must be confirmed by a fetched SEC document stating the ratio (8-K/EX-99); a provider factor that is not a stock split (e.g. a spin-off price factor) is labelled PROVIDER_NON_SPLIT_FACTOR with its SEC source and the title's TOTAL_RETURN window is cut at that date unless the distribution is separately modelled.
splitConsistency.check: companyfacts us-gaap:CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared quarterly facts are compared (MATCH/MISMATCH/UNMATCHABLE) as a cross-check only.

completeness.quarterStatus: COVERED (exactly one admitted regular event with record date in the quarter) | GAP_NO_SEC_ATTESTATION | GAP_RECORD_DATE_NOT_STATED | GAP_CONFLICT | GAP_MULTIPLE_RECORD_DATES
completeness.totalReturnWindows: maximal runs of consecutive COVERED expected quarters; returnBasis TOTAL_RETURN is permitted only for holding periods whose every week lies inside one window (window start = first day of its first quarter, end = last day of its last quarter, additionally cut at PROVIDER_NON_SPLIT_FACTOR dates). Outside: PRICE_RETURN only. No dividend is inferred from neighbouring quarters.
completeness.separation: PRICE_RETURN | TOTAL_RETURN | CA_UNRESOLVED (series not qualified by createResearchLoader {identityEvidence, corporateActionEvidence}) | TERMINAL_UNKNOWN (terminal proceeds without sourced pay date) are reported as separate labels; none is merged into another.

registerFile: quant/engines/research-tr-evidence.cjs is NOT created (no loader change by this strand); the register is docs/quant-recovery/v10/corporate-actions/tr-register-1.0.0.json, shaped for direct use as research-portfolio.cjs CASH_DIVIDEND events (effectiveDate = first weekly session on/after exDateDerived, payDate, amount in series units, informationAvailableAt = SEC acceptance, sourceHash).
parity: One TR ledger per title over its longest TOTAL_RETURN window: research-portfolio.cjs runPortfolio (buy at the first execution session, hold, dividend cash credited at the first weekly session on/after payDate, not reinvested, no costs) vs an independent Python stdlib re-computation from the series file and the register (not a port of the JS code). Tolerance 1e-9 relative on end value.
